CONVERGED OR FALSIFIED: delta vs the base <= 0, or losses on previously-correct dispatched samples offset the reachability gains — widening is declared exhausted at this tier, the mini-campaign ENDS, and the report recommends key-construction work instead. Hard cap 3 rounds; K1 is round 1. Evaluated between rounds only, after every arm of a round has sealed
